text:
isabel: quick q — thinking about the degrade lifecycle on the rollout editor. currently we show 'fallback triggered' lines, but operators want context/history when the same route falls back multiple times. ideas?

tyler: hmm need to be careful with noise. we don't want the UI to blow up for transient spikes. maybe collapse repeated triggers into a single expandable entry with counts and sample traces :eyes:

marta: +1 collapse. also show last successful model version + last error code. helps triage.

josh: what about adding an 'operator note' field on the event so SREs can tag why they paused a policy? small freeform text stored in audit logs.

isabel: that would help. where do we display it though? inline on the rollout timeline or as a modal? my leaning is inline on hover for quick ops, modal for full playbook.

li: agree with inline hover. we should also include a compact diff of policy changes that caused the fallback. something like:

```json
{
  "policy_id": "p-123",
  "degrade_mode": "silent",
  "trigger": "500_rate",
  "changes": ["threshold 80% -> 60%"]
}
```

marta: +1. also think about sampling of triggers so we don't store full request payloads — just a sample id and pointer to traces.

isabel: ok feature sketch: collapsed repeated triggers, sample trace link, inline operator notes, compact policy diff, and a 'replay' button in the modal. does that sound like too much?

tyler: sounds good. needs api changes though: audit events -> add fields: note, sample_trace_id, change_summary. @josh can you estimate?

josh: will do. ballpark: 2-3 backend days + 1 frontend day for inline + modal prototype. need to check retention implications.

devops-bot: reminder: any audit schema change requires migration window and sign-off from security. See runbook: https://internal/runbooks/audit-schema

isabel: thanks. i'll make a tiny PR with wireframes and link to this thread. can we keep this low-friction for GA? maybe gated behind feature flag.

marta: yes feature flag. and add quota guard — don't let operator notes exceed 2k chars.

isabel: noted. i'll post the PR later today :thumbsup:
